current_difficulty_reason: The usual maximum principle cannot be applied across cone points before the new metric is proved to have punctured-disc conformal type. Section4 constructs equivariant Euclidean immersions from the Codazzi data, controls their cone-point limits and projects to a flat metric to rule out annulus conformal type despite only continuous extension. This nonroutine local argument closes the global rigidity proof in Section3 without imposing extra cone-angle assumptions.
